description: Defines the StringInterface interface for locale strings in Drupal, including methods for managing string identifiers, content, storage, locations, and type checks.

classes.name: StringInterface
classes.description: Interface defining methods for locale string objects in Drupal, including getters, setters, storage management, location handling, and type checks.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier of the string.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the string.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of the string.

methods.name: setVersion
methods.description: Sets the version of the string.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Gets the plain string contained in the object.

methods.name: setString
methods.description: Sets the string content of the object.

methods.name: getPlurals
methods.description: Splits and retrieves plural variants of the string.

methods.name: setPlurals
methods.description: Sets plural variants, serializing them with a delimiter.

methods.name: getStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the storage interface used for this string.

methods.name: setStorage
methods.description: Sets the storage interface for this string.

methods.name: isNew
methods.description: Checks if the string is not yet saved to storage.

methods.name: isSource
methods.description: Checks if the string is a source string.

methods.name: isTranslation
methods.description: Checks if the string is a translation string.

methods.name: setValues
methods.description: Sets multiple property values for the string.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves property values for specified fields.

methods.name: getLocations
methods.description: Gets location info for the string, optionally only new locations.

methods.name: addLocation
methods.description: Adds a location to the string.

methods.name: hasLocation
methods.description: Checks if the string has a specific location.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the string object to storage.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the string object from storage.
